in_sanskrit.name: Nagu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Serpent, Cobra
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nagu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Nagas are serpent deities. 'Nagu' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'naga', meaning 'serpent' or 'cobra'. These deities are considered protectors and givers of life. They are also associated with water, fertility, and medicine.
